newsitem.title: INDIA: India rupee seen rising more v dlr unless RBI buys.
newsitem.headline: India rupee seen rising more v dlr unless RBI buys.

text.p: * Indian rupee seen gaining further on Friday, unless Reserve Bank of India (RBI) buys dollars, dealers say
* Rupee seen breaking 35.70 per dollar barrier unless RBI intervenes-dealers
* Rupee touched a seven-month high of 35.735 per dollar on Thursday on poor demand for the U.S. currency and central bank inaction
* Dealers uncertain over outlook for Friday
* Some dealers expect RBI to buy dollars and prevent rupee from rising further, others say market will be allowed to determine rate movement

* Business Standard daily reports that RBI has decided not to intervene in forex market to stem rupee's rise unless there is an "extreme provocation" for it do do so. The daily says this decision was arrived at after a meeting between RBI governor Chakravarty Rangarajan and finance minister P. Chidambaram on Saturday
